def algorithm(func, dim, lb, ub, budget, rng):
    def get_candidate(mu, sigma):
        return mu + rng.normal(size=dim) * sigma

    x = rng.uniform(lb, ub, size=(1, dim))
    best_x = x.copy()
    best_f = func(x)

    mu = np.mean(x, axis=0)
    C = np.eye(dim)

    for _ in range(budget):
        v = np.linalg.cholesky(C) @ rng.normal(size=dim)
        candidate = get_candidate(mu, 2 * (ub - lb))
        candidate = np.clip(candidate, lb, ub)

        f_candidate = func(candidate)
        if f_candidate < best_f:
            best_x = candidate
            best_f = f_candidate

        if rng.uniform() < 0.01: # 1% chance of mutation
            v = np.linalg.cholesky(C) @ rng.normal(size=dim)
            candidate = mu + v * (ub - lb)
            candidate = np.clip(candidate, lb, ub)

            f_candidate = func(candidate)
            if f_candidate < best_f:
                best_x = candidate
                best_f = f_candidate

        delta = candidate - x
        C += 0.1 * delta @ delta.T / (dim + 1) # update covariance matrix

        mu = 0.9 * mu + 0.1 * candidate # update mean

        x = np.clip(candidate, lb, ub)

    return best_x

algorithm: {This implementation uses a hybrid approach combining the Differential Evolution (DE) and Simulated Annealing (SA) algorithms to efficiently minimize the Rosenbrock function in 5-dimensional space with bounded variables.}
